tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional SAP Consultant & Product Owner | Requirements Analysis, Integrations & Commerce Platforms
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional SAP specialist with 5+ years of experience bridging business strategy and technical execution for global enterprises like Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in translating complex business requirements into user stories, functional specifications, and scalable architectures across SAP Commerce Cloud (2105/2211), ERP, PIM, and OMS ecosystems. Experienced in stakeholder management, process mapping, and UAT across international agile teams, leveraging generative AI tools to accelerate backlog refinement, roadmap delivery, and technical documentation.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior SAP Product Manager (all genders)
cover_en.hook: ABOUT YOU's rapid international scaling and modern digital commerce ecosystem demand SAP architectures that align technical capabilities directly with fast-moving business goals. Over the past five years at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have operated at the intersection of business and IT, translating complex stakeholder requirements into high-impact SAP solutions, data integrations, and scalable e-commerce features.

bullets.label: Requirements Engineering & Solution Design
bullets.text: Collaborated directly with business stakeholders, product owners, and engineers to translate commercial goals into structured user stories, acceptance criteria, process maps, and functional specifications.

bullets.label: Cross-System SAP & ERP Integrations
bullets.text: Analysed integration bottlenecks and aligned data flows across SAP ERP, PIM, and MDM systems, ensuring consistent catalog data, pricing structures, and order management across international channels.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & UAT Leadership
bullets.text: Steered feature delivery through Scrum and PI Planning ceremonies in Jira and Confluence, coordinating user acceptance testing (UAT) and production rollouts to ensure high adoption.

bullets.label: AI-Driven Efficiency & Documentation
bullets.text: Leveraged generative AI and LLM tools to accelerate requirements discovery, draft functional documentation, and speed up backlog definition for distributed teams.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit and am serving my notice period until 15 December 2026, ready to join on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my SAP experience can drive product success at ABOUT YOU.

tailoring.why_company: ABOUT YOU is redefining fashion e-commerce through technical excellence, personalization, and an agile, tech-first culture. Combining complex enterprise SAP backends with high-velocity digital consumer platforms presents an exciting product challenge. I want to bring my background in SAP Commerce, ERP integrations, and business requirements engineering to help ABOUT YOU build resilient, highly scalable enterprise solutions that empower cross-functional teams.
tailoring.motivation_short: Motivated to bring 5+ years of techno-functional SAP experience, business requirements engineering, and cross-system integration expertise to ABOUT YOU, translating complex business needs into seamless digital commerce products.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Dear Hiring Team, I noticed the Senior SAP Product Manager opening at ABOUT YOU. With 5+ years in techno-functional SAP delivery (Commerce, ERP, PIM) and strong agile requirements analysis at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I would love to connect and discuss how I can contribute.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior SAP Product Manager (all genders) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior SAP Product Manager (all genders) position at ABOUT YOU SE & Co. KG.

With over five years of techno-functional SAP experience across Rockwell Automation and Shell, I specialize in requirements engineering, cross-system ERP/PIM integrations, and agile solution delivery between business and IT teams.

I hold a valid German work permit, am serving my notice period until 15 December 2026, and look forward to speaking with you.

Kind regards,
Kranti Chavan
